sanskrit_verse: audakaं pārvataं vārkṣyam airaṇaं dhānvanaं tathā / durgamadhye gṛhaं kuryāj jalavṛkṣāvṛtaं pṛthak // BrhS_1,1.45
transliteration: audakaṃ pārvataṃ vārkṣyam airaṇaṃ dhānvanaṃ tathā / durgamadhye gṛhaṃ kuryāj jalavṛkṣāvṛtaṃ pṛthak
sph_interpretive_translation: One shall establish a dwelling in inaccessible terrains—watery, mountainous, arboreal, desert, marshy, or within a fortress—distinctly surrounded by water and trees.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from spatial sovereignty aligned with natural seclusion
Causation arises through environmental alignment with Dharma-preserving isolation
Capacity-based responsibility requires mastery over elemental terrains
Restoration logic demands structural retreat from societal degradation
Consciousness alignment necessitates physical separation for spiritual fortification
executable_legal_axioms: IF citizen seeks dharmic refuge THEN authorize establishment in seclusive terrain
IF dwelling site lacks elemental barrier THEN deny structural sanction
IF societal collapse imminent THEN mandate retreat to fortified natural boundary
IF consciousness degradation detected THEN enforce spatial realignment protocol
IF territorial sovereignty unestablished THEN defer habitation rights
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court adjudicates habitation rights based on dharmic terrain alignment; prioritizes seclusion mandates over urban integration when societal decay evident; defers to SPH-established topographical hierarchies in constitutional zoning matters.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa confirms causal link between secluded habitat and consciousness integrity; anupūrvaśaḥ establishes sequential need for environmental withdrawal; proportional responsibility aligns with capacity to sustain isolated living; non-punitive reality rule ensures no coercion towards harmful habitation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion process: Verify terrain conformity to dharmic criteria
Responsibility assumption protocol: Mandate self-sufficiency in chosen habitat
Capacity restoration mechanism: Provide resource access for sustained isolation
Integrity reintegration procedure: Monitor consciousness alignment with environment
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this verse executes Dharma through spatial sovereignty. Justice restores alignment between consciousness and environment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness stands as supreme adjudicator.
